FULL TEXT:
University of Kashmir
NAAC Accredited Grade “A++”
University Campus, Hazratbal, Srinagar 190006, Kashmir.
NOTICE
It is notified for information of all the candidates who have submitted their application form in response
to Advertisement Notice No. 02 of 2025, dated 20.03.2025 for the post of Tutor under Open (SCU-SCU-3)
and Scheduled Caste (SCU-SCU-4) category that the provisional list of applicants along with their
deficiencies, if any, is given in Annexure I and Annexure II to this Notice.
Further, if the candidate finds any discrepancy regarding his/her status, he/she may approach the office
of the Recruitment Section of the University of Kashmir with documentary proof within 07 days from the
date of issuance of this Notice i.e. up to and including 13.01.2026.
No claim after the last date for clearance of deficiencies shall be entertained.
Note:
 The syllabus and scheme of examination for the aforementioned posts shall be notified separately.
Sd/-
Deputy Registrar
Recruitment
No. F/NT-Tutor-ProvList/KU/26
Dated: 06.01.2026

1. Special Secretary to the Vice Chancellor for information of the Hon’ble Vice
Chancellor;
2. I/C Director IT&SS, with the request to please ensure that the Notice is uploaded on
the University website.
3. P.A. to Registrar for information of the Registrar;
4. File
